overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board reviewed the complaint at its meeting and could lawfully delegate the response to the town administrator. The matter was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated the OML at its July 11 meeting by delegating its response to an OML complaint to the town administrator without first substantively discussing it.
allegations.key_passage: Nothing in the regulations prevent a public body, once it has reviewed a complaint during a meeting, from delegating its response to an individual, such as a town administrator.
